strings.How fast the spring runs out of push as: How fast the spring runs out of push as liquid leaves. A big number fades quickly, so the end of the shot is much gentler than the start. A small number holds on, so it stays firm to the end.

strings.How much the machine backs off when the: How much the machine backs off when the coffee suddenly flows fast — which is what happens if the puck cracks or channels. High give = it eases off and rides it out. Low give = it keeps pushing and the shot runs away.
